title: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard
summary: ChromaGun 2: Dye Hard is a first-person puzzle game from PM Studios, released on Switch 2 on February 12, 2026, at $19.99. The physical version has the full game on the cartridge, which is rare for a smaller third-party release, so you can play the box without downloading anything. The digital install is 9.9 GB. Resolution and frame rate figures have not been published by a reliable source yet. With 13 languages, including Spanish, and a low price, it is an inexpensive option for puzzle fans.
